dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software); uses GnuCOBOL with ORCA-specific copybooks and ORCDBMAIN database interface
evidence: grpsys label prefix on CALL statements

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt/billing system - temporary database deletion for real-time preview of medical procedures
purpose.summary: This subprogram checks for the existence of temporary (preview) database records for a patient and, if found, deletes them across multiple tables (syunou, syumei, syutotal, sryacct, sryact, santei, jyurrk, srykarrk, ptcom, ptinf, sryacctplus). It is part of the ORCA real-time preview subsystem for medical billing.

notable_features: CALL ORCDBMAIN with MCP-FUNC string dispatch (DBSELECT, DBFETCH, DBDELETE, DBCLOSECURSOR)
LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA (screen/session parameter area)
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
grpsys label prefix on CALL statements
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCDBMAIN abstraction layer
Deletes across 11 temporary _prv tables in one transaction flow
verdict.notes: Comments contain Japanese text that appears garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The file is part of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt software project. The 'grpsys' token appearing before CALL statements is a GnuCOBOL section-name or label artifact specific to ORCA build tooling.
